# 5 bed detached house for sale

> Set against the spectacular natural backdrop of Avoca, this exceptional five-bedroom detached residence is a beautifully appointed family home where contemporary design, exquisite finishes and breathtaking countryside surroundings come together. Nestled amongst mature woodland and rolling countryside, the property enjoys an enviable sense of privacy and tranquillity.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 5 bed
- Plocha: 175 m²
- Energetická náročnost: B
- Lokalita: The Beeches, Knocknaree Lower, Avoca
- Cena: 675 000 €
